headline: Tabled special permit requests at 287 Crescent Street, 995 Main St, and CAVA Group LLC, plus a zoning resolution amendment.
summary: Items covered special permit requests for 287 Crescent Street, 995 Main St, and CAVA Group LLC, a zoning resolution on MBTA Communities inclusionary zoning, and a mayor's communication on health insurance. All were tabled. The Law Department was asked to review several of them.
decisions: Approved by voice vote a request for the Law Department to review the special permit modification at 287 Crescent Street.
Tabled the special permit modification at 287 Crescent Street by voice vote.
Approved by voice vote a motion to send the special permit application at 995 Main St to the Law Department to opine and review.
Tabled the special permit application at 995 Main St by voice vote.
Approved by voice vote a request for the Law Department to review the resolution amending the MBTA Communities Zoning Ordinance.
Tabled the resolution amending the MBTA Communities Zoning Ordinance by voice vote.
Approved by voice vote a request for the Law Department to review the latest filing for the CAVA Group LLC special permit application.
Tabled the CAVA Group LLC special permit application by voice vote.
Approved by voice vote a request for the Law Department to attend the next meeting to discuss the mayor's communication related to health insurance.
Tabled the mayor's communication related to health insurance by voice vote.

plain_text:
Ordinances & Rules Committee
Meeting Minutes
September 21, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 9:30 p.m.
Present: Councillors Dunn, Harris, Logan, Hanley & McLaughlin.
Absent: None.
Councillor Logan moved approval of the minutes from 8/3/2026. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
Artie Kronefeld, of The Waltham Times, was audio recording the meeting.
First agenda item: Special Permit modification at 287 Crescent Street for Dyer’s Crescent Suites 
LLC 
Attorney Ken Lightner, from Watertown, representing the petitioner, spoke on the petition.
Councillor Logan and reiterated that you are not changing the units to apartment, they are to be 
long term stays. No leases will be issued. Modifying 30 rooms to be long-term stays where now 
there are only 14 rooms for long-term stays. President Logan made a request that was approved 
by a voice vote to have the Law Department review this petition. President Logan moved to table 
the modification. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Second agenda item: Special Permit application at 995 Main St for Service Credit Union
Attorney Micheal Connors, representing the petitioner, spoke on the application. He filed revised 
plans.
Councillors Hanley and Dunn spoke on the petition. Councillor Logan moved to send the 
application to the Law Department to opine and review and to send any information to the 
petitioner and/or Law Department once redacted by Clerk and Councillor Harris. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote. President Logan moved to table the application. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote. 
Third agenda item: Resolution Amending the MBTA Communities Zoning Ordinance to 
Incorporate the City’s Newly Adopted Inclusionary Zoning Requirements 
President Logan made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department 
review this matter. President Logan moved to table the application. The motion was approved by 
a voice vote. 
Councillor Hanley moved to take the CAVA Group LLC special permit application off the table. 
Attorney Connors was present and stated he will have the amended plans as soon as possible. 
Councillor Hanley made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department
review the latest filing form petitioner and for Clerk to release to petitioner once reviewed and 
redacted by Chair and Clerk. Councillor Hanley moved to table the application. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote. 
President Logan moved to take the mayors communication related to health insurance off the 
table. The motion was approved by a voice vote. President Logan made a request that was
approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department attend the next meeting to discuss. 
President Logan moved to table the matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Councillor McLaughlin moved to adjourn. The motion was approved by a voice vote and 
Chairwoman Harris declared the meeting adjourned at 10:10 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Ordinances & Rules Committee
September 24, 2026
